shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab carved in low relief
a band of small repeated motifs running across the width
justification: Both are upright stone slabs carved in shallow relief and organised into an upper figural zone above horizontal banded registers containing small repeated profile motifs, including birds and quadrupeds, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a flat, precisely finished plaque dominated by two large standing human figures and dense rows of tidy, uniform script-like signs, whereas B is a rough, irregular monolith whose imagery is large, isolated animals rendered in bold, plastic, high-shouldered relief with no ordered text.
